faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Answers to the Most Common Questions

items.q: How long does it take to build a website or app?
items.a: It depends on project scope. Simple sites: 2-4 weeks. Full applications: 2-4 months. We define the exact timeline after discussing your requirements.
We use modern tech stacks: React, Next.js, Flutter for mobile, Node.js, Python, n8n, and Shopify. We choose the right technology for each project.
Yes! Every project includes a free support period. We also offer flexible monthly maintenance plans to keep your project running smoothly.

items.q: How much does a Shopify store cost?
items.a: Professional Shopify stores start at very competitive prices with guaranteed quality and fast delivery. Contact us for an accurate estimate for your project.

items.q: Can you work alongside our internal team?
items.a: Absolutely! We work flexibly — whether as consultants, a complementary team, or a fully dedicated team depending on your needs.

items.q: How do you guarantee the quality of your work?
items.a: We follow a rigorous methodology: regular code reviews, comprehensive testing across multiple devices, and we deliver fully documented projects.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Egypt?
items.a: Yes! We work with clients from Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, and worldwide. Our communication is 100% digital with high efficiency.

items.q: What AI automation services do you offer?
items.a: We build autonomous AI agents, automated WhatsApp response systems, n8n workflow automation, and custom data analytics dashboards.
